allowedSourceMaterial.overview: In this action comedy the French boxer Jo Cavalier is charmed on the train to Berlin for the Olympics in Hitler's Germany by the little boy Simon Rosenblum who asks his autograph; when it turns out his adorable young fan is a Jewish orphan in danger of persecution, he risks his one shot at Olympic glory to save Simon and his family, helped only by a German officer-gentleman who became his friend in World War I, by an adventurous escape to Switzerland, Nazi troops on their heals and braving impossible odds in roller coaster-style.

facts.title: Ace of Aces

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With Nazi forces closing in, Jo must rely on an old World War I adversary to steer a desperate family across guarded frontiers.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: En route to the Berlin Olympics, French boxer Jo Cavalier meets a young Jewish orphan in peril, abandoning his athletic ambitions to launch a wild, high-stakes escape to the Swiss border.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, exciting, and lightly comic, balancing wartime tension with crowd-pleasing action.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Gérard Oury turns a wartime chase into a kinetic, good-humored adventure fueled by quick wits, classic comic escapism, and spirited camaraderie.
